items.body: The spec requires each local fixture to expose its named anatomy. The baseline instead records nine occluded fork targets and five occluded attached-shoot targets. Inspection also finds obscured anatomy where the selector reports resolution. The committed oak attached-shoot preview confirms that overlapping foliage prevents isolation of the selected attachment. Deferring a usable visibility fixture to fn20/fn21 leaves this benchmark requirement incomplete.
items.suggestion: Preserve the frozen evidence and add a new version with reproducible, visibly usable local fixtures that retain surrounding connectivity. Validate their actual images before treating anatomical-view coverage as complete.

items.body: `addVisual` treats a missing `gaps.json` artifact as null, and required-artifact validation checks only beauty/coverage images and arrays. Using the actual saved replay pair, I omitted all 24 whole-view gap references in memory and ran `comparePaths`. It returned `comparable`, no reasons, and null gap results reported as unchanged. This violates the requirement to reject incomplete comparison evidence.
items.suggestion: Require a valid, hashed, successful projected-gap result for every passing whole view. Missing required results must make comparison inconclusive. Add a control exercising omission from the artifact manifest.
